hint.intent: Ask the front desk to keep your luggage until check-in.
hint.example: Could I leave my bags here until check-in?

transfer.situation: You have just checked out. You will pick up your luggage at four before going to the airport. Ask the front desk to keep it for you.
transfer.criterion: Ask the front desk to keep your luggage until four.
transfer.example: Could you keep my luggage until four?

reply: Of course. We can keep your bags at the front desk until your room is ready. Did you have any questions about breakfast, Wi-Fi or check-out?

hint.intent: Give the name on the reservation and say how many nights you are staying.
hint.example: Hello, I have a reservation under Alex Chen for two nights.

transfer.situation: You are checking in at a different hotel. You booked under Morgan Lee for three nights. Tell the receptionist your booking name and how long you are staying.
transfer.criterion: Give the booking name Morgan Lee and say the stay is for three nights.
transfer.example: The booking is under Morgan Lee. I’m staying for three nights.
